title.en: BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES CONFIRMINING DEPARTMENT TRANSPORTATION AND COMMUNICATIONS AS THE PRIMARY IMPLEMENTING COORDINATING FOR ALL RAILWAY, PORT AND AIRPORT

text.en:
The DOTC shall maintain a master plan for each mode of
transportation
that shall serve as the framework for the development
plans of related agencies. Concerned agencies shall submit any specific
major transportation
project proposal to the DOTC to ensure that it is
consistent
with the approved master plans.
Major projects shall be
defined as projects for the construction or installation of new facilities for
Development
Assistance
implementation
as BOT-type projects, or locally-funded
projects with
costs of more than P300 million.

The DOTC shall promulgate guidelines to implement this
Order for dissemination
to all concerned agencies within one (1) month
from its issuance.
All issuances
inconsistent
or contrary
provisions of this Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly,
DONE in the City of Manila, this
the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Seven.
PMS LIBRARY
By the President:
